prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to noise-corrected measurements.
No clear effect was seen for home wait_info changes across 2 tests.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful in one winning test, though no clear effect was seen in another.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign changes (only 1 test conducted so far).
Evidence is still thin for adoption layout changes (only 1 test conducted so far).
Evidence is still thin for finish layout changes (only 1 test conducted so far).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +3.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen: Add a dedicated desktop controls tutorial screen right before the final welcome screen to demonstrate how to interact, hide, and move the desktop pet. (why: Support theme [after_onboarding, confusion] highlights multiple inquiries regarding how to control or hide the pet, and finish step median time is high (395s).)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Audio & Tip Carousel: Add a tip carousel and soft ambient sound toggle to the desktop pet setup waiting screen. (why: The waiting step (home) experiences drop-off (81.3% step conversion) and long wait duration (median 201s, mean 2336s).)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Backup Safeguard Hint: Add a Cloud Save Protected badge and hint explaining account pet persistence on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 emails in support complained about pets disappearing or resetting after re-authenticating.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Welcome Onboarding Completion Guide: Update final desktop welcome headline and body text to guide users on where the pet appears on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not appearing or app failing to open on desktop after onboarding.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Selection Summary Screen: Insert a companion summary screen right after pet pick screen to confirm pet selection before photo upload/certificate generation. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest conversion hurdle (60.9% conversion), requiring clear confirmation before asset processing.)

scores.note: Targets 32% drop-off at finish step with support evidence, but adding a new screen increases implementation cost.
Addresses long wait times at home step, but prior wait_info tests showed no clear positive effect.
Strong support mail alignment and proven positive results (+3.2%) for sign_in hint changes with low cost.
Low-cost copy change addressing specific post-onboarding support issues at the finish step.
Targets biggest hurdle (adoption), but adding new screens in adoption previously reduced conversion (-3.5%).
